newsitem.title: USA: Koger Equity to redeem outstanding warrants.
newsitem.headline: Koger Equity to redeem outstanding warrants.

text.p: Koger Equity Inc said on Friday that it had called for redemption and would redeem all its outstanding common share purchase warrants at a redemption price of $3.81 per warrant.

Under the terms of the warrant agreement, warrant holders may buy one share of Koger common stock, par value $0.01 per share, at an exercise price of $8.00 per share on the redemption date, set for August 29.
The warrants will continue to trade on the American Stock Exchange through August 28, the day immediately prior to the redemption date, the company said in a statement.
Koger Equity is a Florida-based real estate investment trust.
